title: WDAC MULTI-POLICY GPO DEPLOYMENT
subtitle: APP CONTROL FOR BUSINESS
AUDIT + ENFORCE GPOs
ONE ENABLED LINK
{GUID}.cip VIA CiTool
NEVER DOWNGRADE
description: A reference device builds an Audit and an Enforce package from one enforced App Control policy and publishes them to two GPOs in SYSVOL. Both GPOs are linked to the target OU with exactly one link enabled. Windows 11 endpoints in the OU run Deploy-WDACPolicy.ps1 as SYSTEM from the startup script and a recurring scheduled task, verify the SHA-256 hash, and deploy the multiple-policy {GUID}.cip with CiTool only when the version is higher. Win32_DeviceGuard then reports the two DISA STIG values: V-243450 kernel mode and V-243451 user mode, where 0 is OFF, 1 is AUDIT and 2 is ENFORCING.

cards.title: V-243450
cards.subtitle: STIG ID WPAW-00-001050 · CAT II · kernel mode
lines: CodeIntegrityPolicyEnforcementStatus = 2 (ENFORCING)
Drivers and kernel code. Windows' own policies already enforce it.
Reads 2 in Audit mode AND in Enforce mode

cards.title: V-243451
cards.subtitle: STIG ID WPAW-00-001060 · CAT II · user mode (UMCI)
lines: UsermodeCodeIntegrityPolicyEnforcementStatus
Apps, DLLs, installers. Needs option 0 (UMCI) ON and option 3 (Audit Mode) OFF.
Audit 1 (AUDIT) · Enforce 2 (ENFORCING)
